About this product

  • Release date: 24 October 2025.

The PlayStation 5 Console Disc Slim offers high-quality visuals and fast loading with a sleek, compact design. It features a 1000GB SSD for quick game access, ray tracing for realistic shadows and reflections, and 4K TV gaming for sharp detail. HDR support delivers a wide colour range, while the DualSense wireless controller's haptic feedback lets you feel in-game actions. The built-in Blu-ray disc drive plays physical game discs and movies. ASTRO'S PLAYROOM comes pre-installed to get you started.

This is home console gaming designed for players aged 7 and over. The slim build fits easily into your setup, and you'll have access to PlayStation exclusives and multi-platform titles. Whether you're playing single-player adventures or multiplayer games, the console handles different game types with fast loading. The disc drive gives you the option to play physical game discs alongside digital downloads. Everything you need is included in the box with the console, DualSense wireless controller, disc drive, 2 horizontal stand feet, HDMI cable, AC power cord, USB cable, and printed materials.

This is home console gaming designed for players aged 7 and over. The slim build fits easily into your setup, and you'll have access to PlayStation exclusives and multi-platform titles. Whether you're playing single-player adventures or multiplayer games, the console handles different game types with fast loading.

The disc drive gives you the option to play physical game discs alongside digital downloads. Everything you need is included in the box with the console, DualSense wireless controller, disc drive, 2 horizontal stand feet, HDMI cable, AC power cord, USB cable, and printed materials.

Ray Tracing: Immerse yourself in worlds with a new level of realism as rays of light are individually simulated, creating true-to-life shadows and reflections in supported PS5 games.

4K-TV Gaming: Play your favourite PS5 games on your stunning 4K TV.

HDR Technology: With an HDR TV, supported PS5 games display an unbelievably vibrant and lifelike range of colours.

Haptic Feedback: Experience haptic feedback via the DualSense wireless controller in select PS5 titles and feel the effects and impact of your in-game actions through dynamic sensory feedback.

  • 1000 GB hard drive to play games, watch movies and music.
  • Built-in Blu-ray disc drive.

Included:

  • 1 wireless controller - DualSense.
  • AC power cord.
  • USB cable.
  • AC adaptor.
  • Size H35.9, W43.1, D16.9cm.
  • For ages 7 years and over.
  • Box Contents: Wireless controller, Disc Drive, 2 Horizontal Stand Feet, HDMI cable, AC power cord, USB cable, printed materials & ASTRO's PLAYROOM (Pre-installed game).
  • EAN: 711719021230.
